name: openspec-verify-change
description: Use this skill at Step 7 of the v2 SOP to verify that all tasks in the active OpenSpec change are implemented and align with their specs. Cross-checks tasks.md checkboxes against actual code presence, runs per-spec acceptance criteria as smoke tests where possible, and surfaces unimplemented artifacts. Verify is a HARD GATE: failure routes back to Step 6 (openspec-apply-change) until clear. Chinese trigger examples: "OpenSpec verify", "Step 7", "核验变更", "检查未实现工件". Do NOT use to judge code quality (that's Step 8 review), do NOT use to verify compliance (that's Step 10). Success = every task checked, every spec has evidence, unimplemented-artifact list is empty.
